items.areaDesc: Catalina and Santa Barbara Islands; Malibu Coast; Los Angeles County Beaches
items.classification: FACT about the issued alert; hazard is conditional
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to
elevated surf. There is a risk of moderate coastal flooding
especially Monday and Tuesday.

* WHERE...Catalina and Santa Barbara Islands, Malibu Coast and
Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore. Moderate flooding of sea water is possibly over
some vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the
late morning high tide, including over beach parking lots,
bike paths, and harbor walkways. Moderate beach erosion is
likely. Isolated damage is possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Coastal Flood Advisory products will
likely be needed for Monday and Tuesday.

items.areaDesc: Santa Barbara County Southwestern Coast; Santa Barbara County Southeastern Coast; Ventura County Beaches
items.classification: FACT about the issued alert; hazard is conditional
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to
elevated surf. Minor tidal overflows possible especially
Monday and Tuesday.

* WHERE...Santa Barbara County Southwestern Coast, Santa Barbara
County Southeastern Coast and Ventura County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore. Pooling of sea water is possible around high tide at
beach and harbor areas (including Santa Barbara Harbor).
Enhanced beach erosion is also possible. No significant damage
is expected.

items.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
items.classification: FACT about the issued alert; hazard is conditional
items.description:
* WHAT...Elevated surf of 3-5 feet with sets up to 6 feet
through next Tuesday. Astronomical tides of 6.0-6.5 feet
through Sunday, rising to 6.5-7.0 feet Monday through
Wednesday leading to minor tidal overflow.

* WHERE...Beaches of Orange and San Diego Counties.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor tidal overflow and minor coastal erosion
expected during high tides. Additionally, elevated surf will
lead to strong rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides will approach 7.0 feet each
morning Monday through Wednesday. These water levels in
combination with elevated surf provides a window for moderate
coastal flooding on Monday and Tuesday, especially along south
and southwest-facing beaches.
